Private Function Tried(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim r As Range
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("A1:C10"))
    Case 1
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:C10"), ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"))
    Case 2
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("C1:C3,A1:A3"), ws.Range("A1:C10"))
    Case 3
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("C2:C5,A2:A5"))
    Case 4
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("A2:C2,A3:C3"))
    Case 5
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:B2,B2:C3"), ws.Range("A1:C3"))
    Case 6
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:C3"), ws.Range("A1:B2,B2:C3"))
    Case 7
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:B5"), ws.Range("A1:A2,A3:A5"))
    Case 8
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,A5:A7"), ws.Range("A2:A6"))
    Case 9
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("E1:E3"))
    Case 10
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("A1:C10"), ws.Range("B1:C2"))
    Case 11
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("A1:C10"), ws.Range("A2:C2,C3"))
    Case 12
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:C3"), ws.Range("B2"))
    Case 13
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,C1:C3"), ws.Range("A2,C2,A2"))
    Case 14
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1,C1,B1"), ws.Range("A1:C1"))
    Case 15
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A3,A2"), ws.Range("A1:A5"))
    Case 16
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A2,A1:A3"), ws.Range("A1:A5"))
    Case 17
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:B1,A2:C2"), ws.Range("A1:C2"))
    Case 18
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1,B1,A2,B2"), ws.Range("A1:B2"))
    Case 19
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1,A3,A2"), ws.Range("A1:A3"))
    Case 20
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1,B2,B1,A2"), ws.Range("A1:B2"))
    Case 21
        Set r = Application.Intersect(ws.Range("A1:A2,A2:A3"), ws.Range("A1:A5"))
    End Select
    If r Is Nothing Then
        Tried = "Nothing"
    Else
        Tried = r.Address(False, False) & "~" & r.Areas.Count & "~" & r.Cells.CountLarge
    End If
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long, wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    For i = 0 To 21
        s = s & "|" & Tried(wb.Worksheets(1), i)
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
